cases.sentence: Господь пожалеет Иакова. Он вновь изберет ___ и поселит их на их земле.
cases.translation: The Lord will have compassion on Jacob; he will again choose Israel and settle them in their land.
cases.explain: Израиль is the direct object of изберет (will choose), requiring accusative case.

cases.sentence: Чужеземцы присоединятся к ним и пристанут к ___ Иакова.
cases.translation: Foreigners will join themselves to them and cling to the house of Jacob.
cases.explain: дому follows the preposition к (to), which requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Народы возьмут Израиля и приведут на их место. А дом Израиля... завладеет ___ как слугами.
cases.translation: The peoples will take Israel and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess the nations as servants.
cases.explain: народами follows the verb завладеет (will possess), requiring instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В тот ___, когда Господь даст тебе облегчение от боли, ты запоешь песню.
cases.translation: On that day when the Lord gives you relief from your pain, you will sing a song.
cases.explain: день is a time expression with в (on/in), requiring accusative case.

cases.translation: The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of rulers.
cases.explain: жезл is the direct object of Сломал (broke), requiring accusative case.

cases.translation: The oppressor is no more; his fury has ceased.
cases.explain: гонителя follows Не стало (is no more), which requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Как ты пал с ___, утренняя звезда, сын Зарии?
cases.translation: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn!
cases.explain: небес follows пал с (fell from), which requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты стал слаб, как мы. Ты нам уподобился. Слава твоя сошла в мир мертвых вместе с пением твоих арф, на ___.
cases.translation: You have become weak like us. Your glory has descended to the underworld with the sound of your harps, to the earth.
cases.explain: землю is the direct object of implied verb, requiring accusative case.

reading.ru: Господь пожалеет Иакова. Он вновь изберет Израиль и поселит их на их земле.
reading.question: What will the Lord do for Jacob and Israel?
options: Have compassion, choose them again, and settle them in their land
Give them all the world's wealth
reading.correct: Have compassion, choose them again, and settle them in their land
reading.explain: The passage describes God's restoration of Israel to their own land.

reading.ru: Чужеземцы присоединятся к ним и пристанут к дому Иакова.
reading.question: What will foreigners do?
options: Join themselves to Israel and attach themselves to Jacob's house
reading.correct: Join themselves to Israel and attach themselves to Jacob's house
reading.explain: The verse states that foreigners will join themselves to Israel.

reading.ru: А дом Израиля... завладеет народами как слугами и служанками.
reading.question: What will the house of Israel do?
options: Possess the nations as servants and handmaids
reading.correct: Possess the nations as servants and handmaids
reading.explain: Israel will rule over those who once ruled them.

reading.ru: Не стало гонителя, кончилась его ярость.
reading.question: What has ended?
options: The oppressor is gone and his fury has ceased
reading.correct: The oppressor is gone and his fury has ceased
reading.explain: The passage speaks of the end of oppression and rage.

reading.ru: Все страны в покое и мире запевают песни.
reading.question: What is the condition of the countries?
options: They are at rest and peace, breaking out in song
They are at war and conflict
reading.correct: They are at rest and peace, breaking out in song
reading.explain: The passage describes nations rejoicing in peace with song.

reading.ru: Как пал ты с небес, утренняя звезда, сын Зарии?
reading.question: To whom is this lament addressed?
reading.explain: This taunt song is directed at the fallen king of Babylon, called the morning star.
